description.value:
The Crimson Order binds its disciples to a single cause, deity, or creed, and treats that devotion as the wellspring of all discipline. Trainees renounce personal ambition in favor of steady, ritualized service, treating every combat maneuver as an act of loyalty rather than self-expression.

Because their calling often places them in the thick of open warfare rather than quiet contemplation, these monks adapt their traditional unarmed techniques to work alongside armor and battlefield weaponry, blending martial arts fundamentals with the practical demands of a soldier's life.
